E.T. ("ET phone home") is the user's iOS tmux control-mode client for trigkey. Spec: ~/tmux-ios/SPEC.md; repo: github.com/ericsharma/et-ios (private), local ~/tmux-ios. Bundle ID xyz.ericsharma.et.

Spec v2 (2026-10-15) makes it a general tmux client: the user's trigkey/session-0/<host>-claude setup is only an example and must not be hardcoded (saved servers, tmux discovery, session picker, templates, key-row presets). The user hadn't read the original spec closely.

Decisions (2026-10-14/15): min iOS 18, SFSpeechRecognizer on-device (not SpeechAnalyzer; originally because of Xcode 16.3 — as of 2026-10-16 the mini builds with Xcode 26.6 / iOS 26.5 SDK); new windows for non-trigkey hosts always ssh first. Paid Apple Developer enrollment approved 2026-10-15; signing must be headless via App Store Connect API key. Testing is on the user's iPhone directly, not the Simulator against trigkey.
